findings.claim: Coinbase Q2 2026 8-K: crypto trading volume market share 10.3% (record), up from 9.1% in Q1; average USDC held in products $20B, >30% of USDC in circulation; Subscription & Services 48% of net revenue; consumer trading volume fell to $25.8B from $41.5B y/y (cyclical weakness in spot).
William Blair cut estimates; expects Coinbase total trading volume to fall ~44% in 2026 to $669B, then rebound >32% in 2027; earnings trough 2H26 and recover 2027.
findings.source: Crypto Briefing: William Blair sees Coinbase and Circle benefiting from crypto recovery despite slashing estimates
findings.excerpt: The firm projects total trading volume on the platform will fall roughly 44% in 2026 to $669 billion, before bouncing back over 32% in 2027. Advertisement

findings.claim: Analysts cut Coinbase 2026/2027 estimates; Barclays Underweight expects forecasts to fall unless trading rebounds; Moderate Buy consensus.
